Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

def solve2(I,col=2,bg=7,lc=6):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); O=[row[:] for row in I]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]==bg:
                g=False
                # horizontal
                g|= all(I[r][c+k]==lc for k in range(-1,-2,-1)) and all(I[r][c+k]==lc for k in range(1))
                g|= any(k>=1 and I[r][c-k]==lc for k in range(1,min(c,W-c))) and any((W-1-k)>=c and I[r][c+k]==lc for k in range(1,W-c))
                if g: continue
                # vertical
                g=False
                g|= (I[r-1][c]==lc) if r>0 else False
                g|= (I[r+1][c]==lc) if r<H-1 else False
                g|= (all(I[k][c]==lc for k in range(r-1,r-max(1,c-W+c)+... )))
